blocks.html: A leaf field stored in a search index, with the capabilities declared on it.

types.name: name
types.description: Dotted path of the field in the index, e.g. `title` or `variants.sku`.

types.name: searchable
types.description: Whether the field is used for free-text matching.

types.name: filterable
types.description: Whether the field can be used in filters.

types.name: sortable
types.description: Whether results can be sorted by this field.

types.name: facetable
types.description: Whether the field can be faceted.
